description: This file defines the AppShell widget which manages the main layout and navigation structure of a Flutter app, including tab navigation with nested Navigators, animated transitions, and a persistent mini-player sheet.

classes.name: AppShell
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that serves as the main container for the app's navigation, implementing a bottom navigation bar with separate navigators for each tab, animated switching between tabs, and a mini-player sheet.

classes.name: _AppShellState
classes.description: The State class for AppShell, managing current tab index, navigator keys, and building the widget tree with animated transitions and nested navigators.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for this widget.

methods.name: _selectTab
methods.description: Updates the current tab index; if the selected tab is already active, it pops to the first route in that tab's navigator stack.

methods.name: _buildTabNavigator
methods.description: Builds a nested Navigator widget configured with a specific navigator key, initial route, and root widget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the AppShell, including animated transitions, nested navigators for each tab, and the bottom navigation bar.
